Latin word

salūs

salūs, salūtis f.

noun, third declension · Declension on Wiktionary

health, welfare, safety; safety, preservation; the safety of a state; survival, safety, being saved

In this lexicon

  • health

    also used · classical · Cato Agr. 141.3: bonam salūtem valētūdinemque (Lewis & Short)

  • security

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Rep. 1.51: in optimōrum cōnsiliīs posita est cīvitātium salūs; Cic. Sest. 15: commūnis salūs (Lewis & Short)

  • survive

    also used · classical

Examples

  • certē in optimōrum cōnsiliīs posita est cīvitātium salūs

    surely the security of states lies in the counsels of the best menCic. Rep. 1.51
